rules.applicability_conditions: Rule-specific company type, statutory trigger, effective date, exemptions, exceptions, extensions, orders and evidence must be verified; unknown or missing facts remain NOT_EVALUATED.

rules.rule_name: Share Transfer Instrument — Section 38(3) Evidence Review
rules.applicability_conditions: Verify proper transfer instrument duly stamped and executed by transferor/transferee and relevant certificate; account for statutory lost-instrument/indemnity exception.
rules.evidence_requirements: Obtain original/certified instrument, signatures, stamp verification, share certificate, lodgement record and any lost-instrument indemnity.

rules.rule_name: Share Transfer Stamp Duty Requires Verification
rules.statutory_basis: Stamp Act 1899, current Schedule I and applicable amendments
rules.applicability_conditions: Verify instrument category, execution facts, current Schedule I rate, exemptions/adjudication and whether duty was paid; do not infer non-payment from a missing receipt.
rules.evidence_requirements: Obtain executed instrument, stamp certificate/e-stamp record, payment receipt, adjudication/exemption order and current schedule.

rules.statutory_basis: Section 38(7), Companies Act 1994 (Bangladesh), and the company's Articles
rules.applicability_conditions: Only if the operative Articles restriction and its applicability to this transfer are verified; board approval is not a universal statutory requirement.
rules.evidence_requirements: Obtain current Articles, share class/transfer instrument, notice to company, board decision, refusal/registration record and relevant shareholder agreements.

rules.rule_name: Notice of Refusal to Register Transfer
rules.applicability_conditions: Only where refusal to register is verified; company must notify both transferor and transferee within 30 days after the instrument is lodged.
rules.evidence_requirements: Obtain instrument lodgement receipt/date, board/refusal decision, notices to both parties, dispatch and delivery proof.

rules.rule_name: Registered Transfer Despite Articles Restriction — Counsel Review
rules.statutory_basis: Section 38(7), Companies Act 1994 (Bangladesh), and the company's Articles
rules.applicability_conditions: Only where transfer registration is verified despite a specific operative Articles restriction and absence of required approval; no automatic voidness conclusion.
rules.evidence_requirements: Obtain operative Articles clause, transfer instrument, approval/refusal record, register entry, notices and any court/rectification order.

rules.statutory_basis: Sections 34 and 38, Companies Act 1994 (Bangladesh), and applicable Articles
rules.applicability_conditions: Composite internal review only when two or more independently verified transfer-record signals exist; no automatic breach, invalidity or title conclusion.
rules.evidence_requirements: Link each constituent signal to its own authenticated evidence, provenance, date, current status and counsel disposition.
